name: 06 Validation and delivery
intro: How work is tested, validated and delivered: Engineering's tests, Quality's validation and findings, the tested pull request, the daemon's push, the draft PR and its body, CI watching, the no-CI declaration, the failed-validation limit and the end of a job. One question is a conflict between AssemblyAI#9 and AssemblyAI#18; two come from silences. When you accept it I commit it and start 07 Limits, holds and visibility.
notes: Rule 14 states ADR 0007's "a fixed order of checks" as the order of the five tested-PR conditions; no ticket gives another order.
Rule 25 adds to the AsmAI section the rebase exception you decided on the 05 board.
Rule 27: for a PR opened with "[not ready]", marking it ready means removing that prefix, read from AssemblyAI#18's "until then".
Rules 40 and 41 apply the reconciliation rules of AssemblyAI#8 to the two crash cases C40 and C46: fetch origin before pushing again, and look for an existing PR before opening one.
Rule 21: the daemon learns which PR to follow from the leader's effect record; no ticket says how, and this needs no new command.
